whatToTestReadBack.whatsNew:
Build 112: authored action poses for every creature.

All 143 catalog creatures and all 12 custom-avatar bases have four independently drawn poses: idle, windup, action and reaction. Atlas loading now uses bounded memory so the expanded sprite collection need not stay decoded at once.

Compare several species and custom fighters: birds, sea animals, insects, pets, farm animals, fantasy creatures and gods. Look for recognizable designs, distinct poses, complete limbs/tails/wings and stable size. Try 4v4, rematch, background/resume, Reduce Motion and shared cards. Watch for blank or mismatched art after many battles or switching screens.

Custom creation still uses typed names and stable on-device avatars. A visual custom-character editor is a proposal, not a shipped feature. Existing gameplay costs, results and narration behavior remain unchanged.

Report build, device/iOS version and reproduction steps. Verify retained progress/PIN and real account capabilities on your device; simulator evidence does not replace owner acceptance.
